the decreased expression of IDO on DCs in ITP is associated with immune tolerance disorder.

IDO+ DC stimulated with CTLA-Ig could suppress T cells proliferation and T cells activation, promote lymphocyte apoptosis and increase the percentage of Treg, which may be a promising therapeutic strategy for ITP.
